body.id: Paritas: genap + genap = genap, ganjil + ganjil = genap, genap + ganjil = ganjil. Sering kali itu cukup untuk membuktikan sesuatu mustahil.
body.en: Parity: even + even = even, odd + odd = even, even + odd = odd. Often that's enough to prove something is impossible.

body.id: Prinsip sarang merpati: dari 13 orang, pasti ada 2 yang lahir di bulan yang sama, karena hanya ada 12 bulan.
body.en: The pigeonhole principle: among 13 people, 2 must share a birth month, because there are only 12 months.

body.id: Satu contoh penyangkal cukup untuk membantah klaim "semua"; sebuah bukti harus berlaku untuk semua kasus.
body.en: One counterexample is enough to refute an "all" claim; a proof must cover every case.

body.id: Bilangan prima hanya habis dibagi 1 dan dirinya sendiri: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, …
body.en: A prime is divisible only by 1 and itself: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, …

body.id: Aritmetika jam menghitung sisa bagi: pukul 15.00 ditambah 10 jam adalah pukul 01.00, karena 25 dibagi 24 bersisa 1.
body.en: Clock arithmetic counts remainders: 15:00 plus 10 hours is 01:00, because 25 divided by 24 leaves 1.

body.id: Angka terakhir ISBN-13 adalah angka cek: kalikan angka-angkanya bergantian dengan 1 dan 3; totalnya harus kelipatan 10.
body.en: The last digit of an ISBN-13 is a check digit: multiply the digits alternately by 1 and 3; the total must be a multiple of 10.

meaning.id: Untuk setiap bilangan bulat n: selalu genap atau selalu ganjil?
meaning.en: For every whole number n: always even or always odd?

model_answer.id: Selalu genap: 2n; n(n + 1), karena dari dua bilangan berurutan pasti ada yang genap; ganjil + ganjil. Selalu ganjil: 2n + 1; n² + n + 1, yaitu n(n + 1) + 1; 4n − 1.
model_answer.en: Always even: 2n; n(n + 1), because one of two consecutive numbers is even; odd + odd. Always odd: 2n + 1; n² + n + 1, which is n(n + 1) + 1; 4n − 1.

meaning.id: Dalam pertemuan 9 orang, setiap orang bisa bersalaman dengan tepat 3 orang lain.
meaning.en: At a gathering of 9 people, everyone can shake hands with exactly 3 others.

model_answer.id: Salah, mustahil. Setiap salaman melibatkan 2 orang, jadi jumlah "ujung salaman" harus genap; padahal 9 × 3 = 27, ganjil.
model_answer.en: False, it's impossible. Every handshake involves 2 people, so the count of handshake ends must be even; but 9 × 3 = 27, which is odd.

meaning.id: Dua kotak di pojok berseberangan papan catur 8 × 8 dibuang. Bisakah 31 kartu domino (masing-masing menutup 2 kotak) menutup sisanya?
meaning.en: Two opposite corner squares of an 8 × 8 chessboard are removed. Can 31 dominoes (each covering 2 squares) cover the rest?

text.id: Tidak: kedua pojok itu warnanya sama
text.en: No: the two corners are the same colour
No: the 62 squares left are an odd number

model_answer.id: Tidak bisa. Kedua pojok berwarna sama, jadi tersisa 30 kotak satu warna dan 32 kotak warna lain. Setiap domino menutup 1 kotak hitam dan 1 kotak putih.
model_answer.en: No. Both corners are the same colour, leaving 30 squares of one colour and 32 of the other. Every domino covers 1 black and 1 white square.

meaning.id: Laci berisi kaus kaki 5 warna. Tanpa melihat, minimal berapa yang diambil supaya pasti dapat sepasang warna sama?
meaning.en: A drawer has socks in 5 colours. Without looking, what's the fewest you must take to be sure of a matching pair?

model_answer.id: 5 warna = 5 "sarang". Ambil 5, bisa beda semua; kaus kaki ke-6 pasti menyamai salah satunya.
model_answer.en: 5 colours = 5 "pigeonholes". Take 5 and they could all differ; sock number 6 must match one.

meaning.id: Sebuah kota berpenduduk 1.000.000 orang. Misalkan setiap orang punya paling banyak 150.000 helai rambut. Paling sedikit berapa orang pasti punya jumlah helai yang persis sama?
meaning.en: A city has 1,000,000 people. Suppose everyone has at most 150,000 hairs. At least how many people must have exactly the same number of hairs?

model_answer.id: Ada 150.001 kemungkinan jumlah helai (0 sampai 150.000). 1.000.000 : 150.001 ≈ 6,67, jadi ada jumlah helai yang dimiliki paling sedikit 7 orang.
model_answer.en: There are 150,001 possible hair counts (0 to 150,000). 1,000,000 ÷ 150,001 ≈ 6.67, so some hair count is shared by at least 7 people.

meaning.id: Urutkan bukti Euclid bahwa bilangan prima tak terhingga banyaknya.
meaning.en: Order Euclid's proof that there are infinitely many primes.

text.id: Jadi faktor prima N tidak ada di daftar: kontradiksi.
text.en: So N's prime factors are not on the list: a contradiction.

text.id: Andaikan bilangan prima hanya p₁, p₂, …, pₙ.
text.en: Suppose the only primes are p₁, p₂, …, pₙ.

text.id: N dibagi prima mana pun di daftar selalu bersisa 1.
text.en: N divided by any prime on the list leaves 1.

model_answer.id: Andaikan → bentuk N → sisa 1 → kontradiksi. Contoh: 2 × 3 × 5 × 7 + 1 = 211, bilangan prima di luar daftar.
model_answer.en: Suppose → build N → remainder 1 → contradiction. Example: 2 × 3 × 5 × 7 + 1 = 211, a prime not on the list.

meaning.id: Klaim: n² + n + 41 selalu prima. Mana contoh penyangkalnya?
meaning.en: Claim: n² + n + 41 is always prime. Which is a counterexample?

model_answer.id: n = 40: 40² + 40 + 41 = 1.681 = 41 × 41, bukan prima. Untuk n = 1 dan n = 10 hasilnya 43 dan 151, keduanya prima.
model_answer.en: n = 40: 40² + 40 + 41 = 1,681 = 41 × 41, not prime. For n = 1 and n = 10 you get 43 and 151, both prime.

meaning.id: Jika hujan, jalan basah. Jalan basah, jadi pasti tadi hujan.
meaning.en: If it rains, the road gets wet. The road is wet, so it must have rained.

model_answer.id: Salah. Jalan bisa basah karena disiram atau pipa bocor. "Jika A maka B" tidak berarti "jika B maka A".
model_answer.en: False. The road could be wet from watering or a leaking pipe. "If A then B" doesn't mean "if B then A".

meaning.id: Berapa 1 + 3 + 5 + … + 9 (5 bilangan ganjil pertama)?
meaning.en: What is 1 + 3 + 5 + … + 9 (the first 5 odd numbers)?

model_answer.id: Jumlah 5 bilangan ganjil pertama = 5² = 25: tiap bilangan ganjil menambah satu "siku" pada sebuah persegi.
model_answer.en: The first 5 odd numbers add up to 5² = 25: each odd number adds one "L" to a square.

meaning.id: Untuk membantah "semua bilangan ganjil itu prima", cukup __
meaning.en: To refute "every odd number is prime", it is enough to __

model_answer.id: Satu contoh penyangkal cukup: 9 ganjil, tetapi 9 = 3 × 3. Memeriksa banyak contoh tidak membuktikan ataupun membantah klaim "semua".
model_answer.en: One counterexample is enough: 9 is odd, but 9 = 3 × 3. Checking lots of examples neither proves nor refutes an "all" claim.

model_answer.en: Parity → 9 people × 3 handshakes; pigeonhole → 13 people and 12 months; contradiction → Euclid's proof; counterexample → n = 40.

meaning.id: Jumlah 5 bilangan ganjil selalu genap.
meaning.en: The sum of 5 odd numbers is always even.

model_answer.id: Salah. Empat bilangan ganjil berjumlah genap, ditambah satu ganjil lagi jadi ganjil. Contoh: 1 + 3 + 5 + 7 + 9 = 25.
model_answer.en: False. Four odd numbers add up to an even number; one more odd number makes it odd. Example: 1 + 3 + 5 + 7 + 9 = 25.

meaning.id: Lemari gelap berisi kemeja 4 warna. Minimal ambil berapa supaya pasti dapat 3 kemeja yang warnanya sama?

model_answer.id: 2 × 4 + 1 = 9: dengan 8 kemeja, bisa saja tiap warna hanya ada 2.
model_answer.en: 2 × 4 + 1 = 9: with 8 shirts, each colour could have just 2.

meaning.id: Klaim: 2ⁿ − 1 selalu prima untuk n ≥ 2. Mana contoh penyangkalnya?
meaning.en: Claim: 2ⁿ − 1 is always prime for n ≥ 2. Which is a counterexample?

model_answer.id: n = 4: 2⁴ − 1 = 15 = 3 × 5. Untuk n = 3 dan n = 5 hasilnya 7 dan 31, keduanya prima.
model_answer.en: n = 4: 2⁴ − 1 = 15 = 3 × 5. For n = 3 and n = 5 you get 7 and 31, both prime.

meaning.id: Bus A berangkat tiap 12 menit, bus B tiap 18 menit. Keduanya berangkat bersama pukul 07.00. Kapan berangkat bersama lagi?
meaning.en: Bus A leaves every 12 minutes, bus B every 18 minutes. They leave together at 07:00. When do they next leave together?

model_answer.id: KPK dari 12 dan 18 adalah 36: 12 = 2² × 3, 18 = 2 × 3², KPK = 2² × 3² = 36. Jadi pukul 07.36.
model_answer.en: The LCM of 12 and 18 is 36: 12 = 2² × 3, 18 = 2 × 3², LCM = 2² × 3² = 36. So at 07:36.

model_answer.id: 50 = 4 × 12 + 2, jadi jarum jam maju 2 jam dari pukul 9: pukul 11.
model_answer.en: 50 = 4 × 12 + 2, so the hands move 2 hours on from 9 o'clock: 11 o'clock.

meaning.id: Unduhan mulai pukul 22.00 dan butuh 15 jam. Selesai pukul berapa? (Tulis jamnya saja, 0–23.)

model_answer.id: 22 + 15 = 37, dan 37 − 24 = 13. Selesai pukul 13.00 keesokan harinya.
model_answer.en: 22 + 15 = 37, and 37 − 24 = 13. It finishes at 13:00 the next day.

model_answer.en: 100 = 14 × 7 + 2: 2 days after Monday is Wednesday.

meaning.id: Contoh ISBN-13: 978-602-1234-56-?. Kalikan angkanya bergantian dengan 1 dan 3, jumlahkan, lalu cari angka cek agar totalnya kelipatan 10.
meaning.en: Sample ISBN-13: 978-602-1234-56-?. Multiply the digits alternately by 1 and 3, add them up, then find the check digit that makes the total a multiple of 10.

model_answer.id: Total berbobot = 107. Angka ceknya 3, karena 107 + 3 = 110, kelipatan 10.
model_answer.en: The weighted total is 107. The check digit is 3, because 107 + 3 = 110, a multiple of 10.

meaning.id: Pada ISBN-13, salah ketik satu angka selalu ketahuan.
meaning.en: In an ISBN-13, mistyping a single digit is always caught.

model_answer.id: Benar. Bobotnya 1 dan 3, jadi mengubah satu angka (sebesar 1–9) tidak pernah menggeser total sebanyak kelipatan 10. Menukar dua angka bersebelahan kadang lolos.
model_answer.en: True. The weights are 1 and 3, so changing one digit (by 1–9) never shifts the total by a multiple of 10. Swapping two neighbouring digits can slip through.

meaning.id: Urutkan langkah memeriksa sebuah ISBN-13.
meaning.en: Order the steps for checking an ISBN-13.

text.en: Check: is the total a multiple of 10?

text.id: Kalau bukan, ada angka yang salah ketik

model_answer.en: Multiply by 1 and 3 in turn → add up → check for a multiple of 10 → if not, something was mistyped.

items.source: J. C. Lagarias, 'The 3x+1 problem and its generalizations', American Mathematical Monthly 92 (1985): 3-23; Wolfram MathWorld, 'Collatz Problem'.

model_answer.id: Masalah Collatz (1937): mulai dari bilangan bulat positif mana pun; kalau genap, bagi 2; kalau ganjil, kali 3 lalu tambah 1. Semua bilangan yang pernah dicoba komputer akhirnya sampai ke 1, tetapi belum ada yang bisa membuktikan bahwa itu selalu terjadi.
model_answer.en: The Collatz problem (1937): start with any positive whole number; if it's even, divide by 2; if it's odd, multiply by 3 and add 1. Every number ever tried by computer ends up at 1, yet nobody has proved that it always happens.

meaning.id: Sebuah bilangan dibagi 3 bersisa 2, dibagi 5 bersisa 3, dan dibagi 7 bersisa 2. Berapa bilangan terkecil itu?
meaning.en: A number leaves 2 when divided by 3, 3 when divided by 5, and 2 when divided by 7. What is the smallest such number?

model_answer.id: 23 = 7 × 3 + 2 = 4 × 5 + 3 = 3 × 7 + 2. Teka-teki ini berasal dari buku Tiongkok kuno Sunzi Suanjing.
model_answer.en: 23 = 7 × 3 + 2 = 4 × 5 + 3 = 3 × 7 + 2. This puzzle comes from the ancient Chinese book Sunzi Suanjing.
